migration_policy.reusable_vera_specific_code: Migrate or reimplement under Vera-owned paths after exact-head review and tests.
migration_policy.external_service_or_provider: Keep external implementation, add Vera-owned adapter/interface/currentness checks.
migration_policy.sibling_identity_or_template: Absorb mechanism knowledge only; never transfer identity/state/authority.
migration_policy.private_history_or_assets: Keep protected custody external where appropriate; absorb schemas, retrieval contracts, provenance rules, and privacy gates.

completion_model.represented: Every portfolio repository has an internal module.
completion_model.architecture_absorbed: Its Vera-relevant semantics are expressed in Vera-owned architecture.
completion_model.code_absorbed: Reusable Vera-specific implementation has moved/reimplemented where appropriate.
completion_model.provider_bound: External runtime/provider dependency has explicit Vera adapter and currentness/effect evidence.
completion_model.qualified: Exact Vera-owned subject passes its own tests/review. No earlier stage implies this one.
